mutant.lineText: const u16ok = (v: number, what: string): void => { if (!Number.isInteger(v) || v < 0 || v > 65535) throw new RecordError(`${what} must be 0 to 65535`); };
mutant.nextText: const u32ok = (v: number, what: string): void => { if (!Number.isInteger(v) || v < 0 || v > 0xffffffff) throw new RecordError(`${what} must be 0 to 4294967295`); };
